name: Update attribute group view
description: Call this when an attribute group view that already exists in the CRM object configuration must be changed — renaming the group, or changing which attributes appear in it and in what order. Pass the full intended attribute list, because the observed body carries the complete set rather than a delta. Use crm.create_attribute_group_view instead when no group view exists yet for the object type and a new one must be added; use contacts.create_attribute instead when the underlying attribute itself does not exist, since this action only arranges attributes into a display group and does not define them.
preconditions: The attribute group view identified by the :id path parameter must already exist.
The attributes named in "attributes" must already exist for the given objectType.
The account identified by accountId must be the account the session is authenticated against.
The caller must be authenticated against the CRM backend host (crm-backend-api.brevo.com); a CRM CSRF token may be required, obtainable via crm.get_csrf_token.

id.description: Path parameter. Identifier of the attribute group view to update, e.g. "6aee1aa276e0d73f452f617f".

groupName.description: Display name of the attribute group as shown in the record panel, e.g. "Information".

component.description: Identifier of the UI component the group is rendered in. Observed value: "details". The full set of accepted values is not known from the evidence.

attributes.description: Full ordered list of attribute codes to show in this group, e.g. ["LASTNAME","FIRSTNAME","CRM__EMAIL"]. The list replaces the previous contents of the group; order determines display order.

objectType.description: CRM object the group view belongs to. Observed value: "contact". Other object types exist in the CRM product but are not confirmed by this evidence.

accountId.description: Identifier of the Brevo account owning the configuration, e.g. "6aedca5302b34f2d6e026f4a".

outputs.description: HTTP 200 on success. The response body was not captured in the available evidence, so its shape is unknown.

side_effects: The stored attribute group view is overwritten with the submitted group name and attribute list.
Attributes previously in the group but absent from the submitted list stop being displayed in that group.
The record detail panel for the given objectType changes for every user of the account, not only the caller.
